gripOrHq.title: Reclamation Project
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search the archives for any number of ice cards. Show those cards to Runner, then store them in HQ. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Reclamation Project
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search the archives for any number of ice cards. Show those cards to Runner, then store them in HQ. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Shuffle
gripOrHq.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Trapdoor
gripOrHq.rulesText: Install Trapdoor only on R&D or HQ. *Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a subsidiary data fort of your choice, instead of passing Trapdoor. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort. Runner automatically breaks this subroutine if there are no subsidiary data forts.

heapOrArchives.title: Strategic Planning Group
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards, draw an extra card. Then place one of the drawn cards on the bottom of R&D. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

rig.title: Armageddon
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, you may choose to give the Corp a Doom counter instead of accessing cards from R&D. Each Doom counter forces the Corp to roll a die whenever it installs a card. On a 6, the card is trashed after it is installed, and the Corp removes a Doom counter. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Theorem Proof
rig.rulesText: If Runner accesses Theorem Proof, he or she does not score it, but instead may install it as a 2 MU program that has the ability "A: Score Theorem Proof" but is removed from the game if it leaves play in any other way.

ice.title: Bolter Swarm
ice.rulesText: *Do 4 Net damage. *Runner cannot break any subroutines on the next piece of ice encountered during this run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Bolter Swarm is reduced by [5].

root.title: Sterdroid
root.rulesText: [3], [T]: Choose a piece of ice. That ice's strength is doubled until end of turn. If this would raise the ice's strength above 10, its strength becomes 10.

ice.title: Deadeye
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Deadeye is reduced by [5].

root.title: Unlisted Research Lab
root.rulesText: Draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns.
